# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/unattended), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — the trajectory ledger core (issue #10): finalized
  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through
  `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder.append`/`applyEvent` — streamed agent events
  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are
  replaced when the real record lands; revision grows per append. Record
  kinds (closed set, `TrajectoryCellKind`): system, user, context,
  compacted, message, tool, subtool — a subtool is a
  `TrajectoryToolRecord.parentCallId != null`, which only hosts build
  directly (the builder never nests). Derived state folds once per
  snapshot: `deriveTrajectoryLayout` (turns of Message/Step groups +
  collapsible turn/assistant-run summaries), `deriveTrajectoryTimeline`
  (four modes — `sequence` equal-width slots, `duration` with idle gaps
  compressed out, `time` zero-width wall-clock markers, `actual` real gaps;
  three fixed lanes: 0 system/user/context, 1 message/compacted, 2 tools),
  `trajectoryTimelineFocusIndexes` (selection → visible ledger indexes),
  and `ThrottledTrajectorySearchIndex` (full-text; matches are stable
  record ids). `formatters.dart` holds the shared duration/token/throughput
  formatting; `trajectory_preview.dart` the bounded single-line previews;
  `trajectory_export.dart` the whole-snapshot JSON/Markdown exporters the
  header's copy menu uses. Tool records carry `startedAt` (real launch
  time, distinct from the projected position) so the Gantt/actual
  projections plot true spans. Outbound model requests persist for the

- **PR #**: 700
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/700
- **Title**: feat(691): App Store launch surface — links: config, fa1.dev block + goldens page, Get banners, referral analytics
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit

- **State**: open

- **Additions**: +1973

- **Created**: 2026-09-19T18:41:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-09-20T12:09:51Z

## PR Description

Fixes #691

## Delivered

**1. `links:` config section — the foundation (AC1)**
- `lib/src/cli/links_config.dart`: strict-on-shape parse (non-map section, non-URL value, non-boolean banner → `ConfigException`), tolerant notes for unknown keys (AC7), baked-in defaults (appstore / testflight / play: null / site / banner: true), overrides win, `toYaml` round-trip writes only non-default keys.
- Wired into `CliConfig`, `configTopLevelKeys`, `_sectionValidators` (so `fa config get/set/check` treat it as a first-class section — a value the next boot would reject is never persisted) and the disk-preserved save set (a default-valued section never wipes future keys).
- One-change propagation test: flip the link in a `LinksConfig` → site block renderer, in-app banner view, and config get/set all render the new value.

**2. fa1.dev homepage App Store block (AC2, AC6)**
- Generated `#app-store` section (badge + link, paid-release vs free-forever-beta messaging, Android "coming soon" until `links.play` set) between generated markers; `scripts/regen_site_store_block.dart` re-splices it; `test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart` pins byte-equality to the renderer output for the defaults (site can't drift).
- Zero superlative claims — the issue #643 banned-phrase list is asserted on every new surface.

**3. iOS banner page from store goldens (AC3)**
- New `site/app-store/` page shows EXACTLY the five committed en/ios store goldens with the store-story captions.
- `pages.yml` copies `flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png` into the deploy artifact — no hand-copied PNGs exist in the repo, so site assets cannot drift from store assets; the CI test pins page↔golden set equality + the deploy wiring.

**4. Get banners, web + macOS (AC4, AC7)**
- `StoreGetBanner`: dismissible, non-blocking card at the top of Settings (web + macOS only); every URL from the `links:` section via the app loader (web stub = baked-in defaults); dismissal persists (`store_banner.json` in the sandbox root, survives restarts/reloads); `links.banner: false` mounts nothing anywhere.

**5. Store-referral analytics (AC5)**
- In-app: `store_referral {placement, platform}` on banner taps + `store_banner_dismissed` (negative signal) through the AppAnalytics facade.
- Site: `appstore_click {placement}` via `data-store-referral` attrs on every badge (existing `location` param kept for report continuity).
- Counts view: the shared GA4/Firebase property (site gtag + app Firebase already land there) — Events report split by placement/platform/timestamp gives the funnel; no new server (site is static by design).

**Guard rails kept honest**
- `links` documented in the fa-self-config skill (documented-keys sweep + accuracy pins pass); settings-registry classification with a WHY; l10n en+ru for all banner strings; compliance gate extended to the banner + site store copy.
- Analyze: zero errors/warnings, zero issues in touched files (pre-existing infos elsewhere untouched). Dup/crap thresholds NOT touched.

## Remaining
- The GA4 property is the only counts view (no custom dashboard — non-goal-adjacent; a backend would be new surface).
- Android "Get it on Google Play" renders automatically once `links.play` is set (tested with an override; the real link lands when Play ships).
- Store goldens themselves unchanged (post-#643 assets reused as-is).

## Test evidence (local, targeted)
- `dart test`: links_config (21), links_section (12), appstore_assets (6), documented_keys_sweep, settings_completeness, fa_self_config_accuracy, site_llms_guard, cli_config_test, config_service_test — all green.
- `flutter test`: links_loader (6), store_get_banner (7), store_copy_compliance (5), analytics, settings_test — all green. (`settings_golden_test` pixel diffs 1.23% reproduce identically on pristine origin/main in this sandbox — font rasterization, not this change; CI's ubuntu runner renders them clean.)

## Update (rebase + format pass, head 2bc605c0)
- Rebased onto the latest `origin/main` (6cf2c026 — includes the #708 factory repin); content identical to the previous merge head plus the pass below. No conflicts.
- Applied the repo `dart format` to the four touched files the first pass left unformatted (`cli_config.dart`, `flutter_agent_harness.dart` exports, `settings.dart`, `analytics.dart`) — pure reflow, zero semantics, keeps the CI format gate green.
- All targeted gates re-run green on the rebased tree: links_config (21), links_section (12), appstore_assets (6), fa_self_config_accuracy (6), app_bundle_drift (3), store_get_banner (7), links_loader + store_copy_compliance (18 combined).

## CI unblock rider (head 7796555f)
`test/hub/hub_fallback_drill_test.dart` — AC2 UT-fallback — was a deterministic ×2 red on **Core tests (shard 0/4)** (9904abbc / job 105996265643 and 83b09762 / job 105998766365): `SocketException: Address already in use` (errno 98) at `LocalHub.start` on the drill's hub-restart bind, with different ports per run (41663 vs 39459). Cause: the drill picked its port via bind-`:0`→close→rebind, so the restart rebind of the freed port raced the shard's concurrent suites (a neighbor's `:0` bind can be handed the just-freed port and hold it). Fix (test-only, rider commit `7796555f`): every drill hub now binds `:0` and the restart takes a fresh ephemeral port, with the test-owned `GatedTransport` repointing dials at the live hub port — `lib/` untouched.

# gh-691: [GOAL] App Store launch surface: fa1.dev block + iOS banner page from store goldens + Get banners (web/macOS) + store-referral analytics

## Description

## Goal — App Store launch surface: fa1.dev homepage + iOS banner page from store goldens, in-app Get banners (web/macOS), store-referral analytics — and a single config home for product links

### Context (owner)
- PUBLISHED: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163 — the revenue stream. App Store release = paid; public TestFlight beta = free forever; Android mirrors it.
- Visual source = the store golden frames (chat, Weather demo) — site reuses golden-test output; post-#643 assets only.

### NEW: single source of truth for links — `links:` config section (owner requirement)
All product/store links live in ONE place — the `links:` section of `~/.fah/config.yaml` (NOT env vars; this section will grow: play, testflight, site, docs, socials…):
```yaml
links:
  appstore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163
  testflight: <public beta link>
  play: <when live>
  site: https://fa1.dev
```
Strict section parse (ConfigException on bad shape, tolerant notes for unknown keys — repo convention). Every consumer (app banners, CLI, site generator) reads the section — a link changes in ONE place and propagates. Defaults baked in for our own products; user-overridable like any config key.

### Scope
1. **`links:` config section** (above) — the foundation everything else reads.
2. **fa1.dev homepage**: App Store block — badge + link (from `links:`), paid vs free-forever-beta messaging, Android slot (renders "coming soon" until `links.play` set). (Site source location resolved in planning; PR lands where the site lives.)
3. **iOS banner/block page**: built from the golden-test store screenshots; CI-checked regenerate-from-goldens (site assets never drift from store assets).
4. **Get banners**: web + macOS apps' Get surface shows the App Store banner (link from `links:`); dismissible (persisted), non-blocking.
5. **Analytics**: store-referral events — site badge clicks (placement), in-app banner taps, platform split; countable funnel to the paid release.

## Acceptance
- AC1: `links:` section parses strict (bad shape = ConfigException), defaults present, override works; app banner + CLI + site all resolve the SAME value from it (one-change propagation test: flip the link in config → every surface renders the new one).
- AC2: fa1.dev homepage shows the App Store block (badge + link + paid/free-beta messaging); Android "coming soon" until play link set.
- AC3: iOS banner page assets regenerate from the golden suite in CI (no hand-copied PNGs).
- AC4: web + macOS Get banner renders from `links.appstore`; dismissal persists; taps emit analytics events.
- AC5: analytics events countable (placement, platform, timestamp) with a minimal counts view.
- AC6: zero superlative claims on any surface (post-#643 assets; compliance list applies to site/banners too).
- AC7 (REG): site/apps build clean; banner flag off = no surface change; unknown links keys = notes, never crash.

## Non-goals
Pricing/IAP mechanics (App Store Connect); the Play paid release; site i18n beyond existing locales; env-var plumbing (deliberately config-only).

## Links
#643 (compliance fix — asset dependency), store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163, goldens: flutter_app/test/services/screenshot_golden_test.dart + store-marketing suite.

+// Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.

+/// Resolves the `links:` config section for the app (issue #691): the
+/// SAME section the CLI and the fa1.dev generator read — the app's Get
+/// banner (web/macOS) never hard-codes a store URL, so a link changes
+/// in ONE place (`~/.fah/config.yaml`) and every surface flips. IO
+/// platforms read the real user config; the web stub reports the
+/// baked-in defaults (the browser sandbox has no `~/.fah`).
+///
+/// Unlike the CLI boot (strict — a bad section is a named error), the
+/// app NEVER bricks on config problems: an unreadable or invalid
+/// section falls back to the defaults with a log note, and
+/// `fa config check` remains the loud surface for the error.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+
+export 'links_loader_stub.dart' if (dart.library.io) 'links_loader_io.dart';
+
+/// The effective app links — always a value (defaults when no config
+/// states a choice), plus the load notes for surfaces that want them
+/// (the banner logs them; `banner: false` hides every banner surface).
+final class AppLinksResolution {
+  const AppLinksResolution(this.links, this.notes);
+
+  /// The effective `links:` section.
+  final LinksConfig links;
+
+  /// Load notes: what fell back and why (empty on a clean load).
+  final List<String> notes;
+}

+// Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
+// Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
+// in the LICENSE file.
+
+/// IO implementation: reads the user `~/.fah/config.yaml` `links:`
+/// section through the SAME core loader the CLI boot uses
+/// ([loadCliConfig] — its `links:` parse is strict, so a bad shape
+/// surfaces here as a fallback-to-defaults note, never a crash: the app
+/// is not the CLI, `fa config check` is the loud surface).
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+
+import 'app_log.dart';
+import '../sandbox/env_factory_io.dart' show desktopHomeDir;
+import 'links_loader.dart';
+
+/// Resolves the effective links for the app banner surfaces.
+/// [homeDir] overrides the user-home lookup (tests inject a temp dir;
+/// default: [desktopHomeDir]). Absent file/section → the baked-in
+/// defaults; unreadable/invalid → the defaults + a note.
+AppLinksResolution resolveAppLinks({String? homeDir}) {
+  final home = homeDir ?? desktopHomeDir();
+  if (home == null) return const AppLinksResolution(LinksConfig(), []);
+  try {
+    final config = loadCliConfig(home);
+    final notes = [for (final note in config.links.notes) 'links: $note'];
+    return AppLinksResolution(config.links, notes);
+  } on Object catch (error) {
+    final note =
+        'links: config unreadable ($error) — store links fell '
+        'back to the defaults; run `fa config check` for the named error';
+    AppLog.i('links', note);
+    return AppLinksResolution(const LinksConfig(), [note]);
+  }
+}

Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. blocks.text:
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/unattended), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — the trajectory ledger core (issue #10): finalized
  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through
  `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder.append`/`applyEvent` — streamed agent events
  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are
  replaced when the real record lands; revision grows per append. Record
  kinds (closed set, `TrajectoryCellKind`): system, user, context,
  compacted, message, tool, subtool — a subtool is a
  `TrajectoryToolRecord.parentCallId != null`, which only hosts build
  directly (the builder never nests). Derived state folds once per
  snapshot: `deriveTrajectoryLayout` (turns of Message/Step groups +
  collapsible turn/assistant-run summaries), `deriveTrajectoryTimeline`
  (four modes — `sequence` equal-width slots, `duration` with idle gaps
  compressed out, `time` zero-width wall-clock markers, `actual` real gaps;
  three fixed lanes: 0 system/user/context, 1 message/compacted, 2 tools),
  `trajectoryTimelineFocusIndexes` (selection → visible ledger indexes),
  and `ThrottledTrajectorySearchIndex` (full-text; matches are stable
  record ids). `formatters.dart` holds the shared duration/token/throughput
  formatting; `trajectory_preview.dart` the bounded single-line previews;
  `trajectory_export.dart` the whole-snapshot JSON/Markdown exporters the
  header's copy menu uses. Tool records carry `startedAt` (real launch
  time, distinct from the projected position) so the Gantt/actual
  projections plot true spans. Outbound model requests persist for the

- **PR #**: 700
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/700
- **Title**: feat(691): App Store launch surface — links: config, fa1.dev block + goldens page, Get banners, referral analytics
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit

- **State**: open

- **Additions**: +1973

- **Created**: 2026-09-19T18:41:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-09-20T12:09:51Z

## PR Description

Fixes #691

## Delivered

**1. `links:` config section — the foundation (AC1)**
- `lib/src/cli/links_config.dart`: strict-on-shape parse (non-map section, non-URL value, non-boolean banner → `ConfigException`), tolerant notes for unknown keys (AC7), baked-in defaults (appstore / testflight / play: null / site / banner: true), overrides win, `toYaml` round-trip writes only non-default keys.
- Wired into `CliConfig`, `configTopLevelKeys`, `_sectionValidators` (so `fa config get/set/check` treat it as a first-class section — a value the next boot would reject is never persisted) and the disk-preserved save set (a default-valued section never wipes future keys).
- One-change propagation test: flip the link in a `LinksConfig` → site block renderer, in-app banner view, and config get/set all render the new value.

**2. fa1.dev homepage App Store block (AC2, AC6)**
- Generated `#app-store` section (badge + link, paid-release vs free-forever-beta messaging, Android "coming soon" until `links.play` set) between generated markers; `scripts/regen_site_store_block.dart` re-splices it; `test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart` pins byte-equality to the renderer output for the defaults (site can't drift).
- Zero superlative claims — the issue #643 banned-phrase list is asserted on every new surface.

**3. iOS banner page from store goldens (AC3)**
- New `site/app-store/` page shows EXACTLY the five committed en/ios store goldens with the store-story captions.
- `pages.yml` copies `flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png` into the deploy artifact — no hand-copied PNGs exist in the repo, so site assets cannot drift from store assets; the CI test pins page↔golden set equality + the deploy wiring.

**4. Get banners, web + macOS (AC4, AC7)**
- `StoreGetBanner`: dismissible, non-blocking card at the top of Settings (web + macOS only); every URL from the `links:` section via the app loader (web stub = baked-in defaults); dismissal persists (`store_banner.json` in the sandbox root, survives restarts/reloads); `links.banner: false` mounts nothing anywhere.

**5. Store-referral analytics (AC5)**
- In-app: `store_referral {placement, platform}` on banner taps + `store_banner_dismissed` (negative signal) through the AppAnalytics facade.
- Site: `appstore_click {placement}` via `data-store-referral` attrs on every badge (existing `location` param kept for report continuity).
- Counts view: the shared GA4/Firebase property (site gtag + app Firebase already land there) — Events report split by placement/platform/timestamp gives the funnel; no new server (site is static by design).

**Guard rails kept honest**
- `links` documented in the fa-self-config skill (documented-keys sweep + accuracy pins pass); settings-registry classification with a WHY; l10n en+ru for all banner strings; compliance gate extended to the banner + site store copy.
- Analyze: zero errors/warnings, zero issues in touched files (pre-existing infos elsewhere untouched). Dup/crap thresholds NOT touched.

## Remaining
- The GA4 property is the only counts view (no custom dashboard — non-goal-adjacent; a backend would be new surface).
- Android "Get it on Google Play" renders automatically once `links.play` is set (tested with an override; the real link lands when Play ships).
- Store goldens themselves unchanged (post-#643 assets reused as-is).

## Test evidence (local, targeted)
- `dart test`: links_config (21), links_section (12), appstore_assets (6), documented_keys_sweep, settings_completeness, fa_self_config_accuracy, site_llms_guard, cli_config_test, config_service_test — all green.
- `flutter test`: links_loader (6), store_get_banner (7), store_copy_compliance (5), analytics, settings_test — all green. (`settings_golden_test` pixel diffs 1.23% reproduce identically on pristine origin/main in this sandbox — font rasterization, not this change; CI's ubuntu runner renders them clean.)

## Update (rebase + format pass, head 2bc605c0)
- Rebased onto the latest `origin/main` (6cf2c026 — includes the #708 factory repin); content identical to the previous merge head plus the pass below. No conflicts.
- Applied the repo `dart format` to the four touched files the first pass left unformatted (`cli_config.dart`, `flutter_agent_harness.dart` exports, `settings.dart`, `analytics.dart`) — pure reflow, zero semantics, keeps the CI format gate green.
- All targeted gates re-run green on the rebased tree: links_config (21), links_section (12), appstore_assets (6), fa_self_config_accuracy (6), app_bundle_drift (3), store_get_banner (7), links_loader + store_copy_compliance (18 combined).

## CI unblock rider (head 7796555f)
`test/hub/hub_fallback_drill_test.dart` — AC2 UT-fallback — was a deterministic ×2 red on **Core tests (shard 0/4)** (9904abbc / job 105996265643 and 83b09762 / job 105998766365): `SocketException: Address already in use` (errno 98) at `LocalHub.start` on the drill's hub-restart bind, with different ports per run (41663 vs 39459). Cause: the drill picked its port via bind-`:0`→close→rebind, so the restart rebind of the freed port raced the shard's concurrent suites (a neighbor's `:0` bind can be handed the just-freed port and hold it). Fix (test-only, rider commit `7796555f`): every drill hub now binds `:0` and the restart takes a fresh ephemeral port, with the test-owned `GatedTransport` repointing dials at the live hub port — `lib/` untouched.

# gh-691: [GOAL] App Store launch surface: fa1.dev block + iOS banner page from store goldens + Get banners (web/macOS) + store-referral analytics

## Description

## Goal — App Store launch surface: fa1.dev homepage + iOS banner page from store goldens, in-app Get banners (web/macOS), store-referral analytics — and a single config home for product links

### Context (owner)
- PUBLISHED: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163 — the revenue stream. App Store release = paid; public TestFlight beta = free forever; Android mirrors it.
- Visual source = the store golden frames (chat, Weather demo) — site reuses golden-test output; post-#643 assets only.

### NEW: single source of truth for links — `links:` config section (owner requirement)
All product/store links live in ONE place — the `links:` section of `~/.fah/config.yaml` (NOT env vars; this section will grow: play, testflight, site, docs, socials…):
```yaml
links:
  appstore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163
  testflight: <public beta link>
  play: <when live>
  site: https://fa1.dev
```
Strict section parse (ConfigException on bad shape, tolerant notes for unknown keys — repo convention). Every consumer (app banners, CLI, site generator) reads the section — a link changes in ONE place and propagates. Defaults baked in for our own products; user-overridable like any config key.

### Scope
1. **`links:` config section** (above) — the foundation everything else reads.
2. **fa1.dev homepage**: App Store block — badge + link (from `links:`), paid vs free-forever-beta messaging, Android slot (renders "coming soon" until `links.play` set). (Site source location resolved in planning; PR lands where the site lives.)
3. **iOS banner/block page**: built from the golden-test store screenshots; CI-checked regenerate-from-goldens (site assets never drift from store assets).
4. **Get banners**: web + macOS apps' Get surface shows the App Store banner (link from `links:`); dismissible (persisted), non-blocking.
5. **Analytics**: store-referral events — site badge clicks (placement), in-app banner taps, platform split; countable funnel to the paid release.

## Acceptance
- AC1: `links:` section parses strict (bad shape = ConfigException), defaults present, override works; app banner + CLI + site all resolve the SAME value from it (one-change propagation test: flip the link in config → every surface renders the new one).
- AC2: fa1.dev homepage shows the App Store block (badge + link + paid/free-beta messaging); Android "coming soon" until play link set.
- AC3: iOS banner page assets regenerate from the golden suite in CI (no hand-copied PNGs).
- AC4: web + macOS Get banner renders from `links.appstore`; dismissal persists; taps emit analytics events.
- AC5: analytics events countable (placement, platform, timestamp) with a minimal counts view.
- AC6: zero superlative claims on any surface (post-#643 assets; compliance list applies to site/banners too).
- AC7 (REG): site/apps build clean; banner flag off = no surface change; unknown links keys = notes, never crash.

## Non-goals
Pricing/IAP mechanics (App Store Connect); the Play paid release; site i18n beyond existing locales; env-var plumbing (deliberately config-only).

## Links
#643 (compliance fix — asset dependency), store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163, goldens: flutter_app/test/services/screenshot_golden_test.dart + store-marketing suite.

+// Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.

+/// Resolves the `links:` config section for the app (issue #691): the
+/// SAME section the CLI and the fa1.dev generator read — the app's Get
+/// banner (web/macOS) never hard-codes a store URL, so a link changes
+/// in ONE place (`~/.fah/config.yaml`) and every surface flips. IO
+/// platforms read the real user config; the web stub reports the
+/// baked-in defaults (the browser sandbox has no `~/.fah`).
+///
+/// Unlike the CLI boot (strict — a bad section is a named error), the
+/// app NEVER bricks on config problems: an unreadable or invalid
+/// section falls back to the defaults with a log note, and
+/// `fa config check` remains the loud surface for the error.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+
+export 'links_loader_stub.dart' if (dart.library.io) 'links_loader_io.dart';
+
+/// The effective app links — always a value (defaults when no config
+/// states a choice), plus the load notes for surfaces that want them
+/// (the banner logs them; `banner: false` hides every banner surface).
+final class AppLinksResolution {
+  const AppLinksResolution(this.links, this.notes);
+
+  /// The effective `links:` section.
+  final LinksConfig links;
+
+  /// Load notes: what fell back and why (empty on a clean load).
+  final List<String> notes;
+}

+// Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
+// Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
+// in the LICENSE file.
+
+/// IO implementation: reads the user `~/.fah/config.yaml` `links:`
+/// section through the SAME core loader the CLI boot uses
+/// ([loadCliConfig] — its `links:` parse is strict, so a bad shape
+/// surfaces here as a fallback-to-defaults note, never a crash: the app
+/// is not the CLI, `fa config check` is the loud surface).
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+
+import 'app_log.dart';
+import '../sandbox/env_factory_io.dart' show desktopHomeDir;
+import 'links_loader.dart';
+
+/// Resolves the effective links for the app banner surfaces.
+/// [homeDir] overrides the user-home lookup (tests inject a temp dir;
+/// default: [desktopHomeDir]). Absent file/section → the baked-in
+/// defaults; unreadable/invalid → the defaults + a note.
+AppLinksResolution resolveAppLinks({String? homeDir}) {
+  final home = homeDir ?? desktopHomeDir();
+  if (home == null) return const AppLinksResolution(LinksConfig(), []);
+  try {
+    final config = loadCliConfig(home);
+    final notes = [for (final note in config.links.notes) 'links: $note'];
+    return AppLinksResolution(config.links, notes);
+  } on Object catch (error) {
+    final note =
+        'links: config unreadable ($error) — store links fell '
+        'back to the defaults; run `fa config check` for the named error';
+    AppLog.i('links', note);
+    return AppLinksResolution(const LinksConfig(), [note]);
+  }
+}

## Automated Code Review — COMMENT

**Summary**: Solid, well-tested implementation of the #691 store surface — strict/tolerant `links:` parsing, one-source-of-truth propagation with drift-pinning tests, and a sound test-only fix for the hub drill port race. No blocking issues; two important findings: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` drops the new `links` field (violating the in-code "keep in sync" contract — today masked only by the disk-preserved re-attach), and both in-app banner buttons log an identical `store_referral` event, so the paid-vs-beta funnel split required by AC5 cannot be counted.

**Next Steps**:
1. Carry `links: links` in `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (cli_config.dart)
2. Add a `target` (appstore/testflight) param to the banner's `store_referral` event (store_get_banner.dart)
3. Optionally: keep `location` semantics unchanged in site/analytics.js, quote URLs in `LinksConfig.toYaml`, localize `androidLabel`, handle `launchUrl` failure

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `withCustomProviders` drops the new `links` field**

The constructor now takes `links` (line 216), but `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (just below, the copy used by `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write union) was not updated — its own doc comment says *"keep this field list in sync with the constructor when a section is added."* The returned copy silently reverts `links` to `const LinksConfig()`.

Today the data loss is masked: `saveCliConfig` emits `toYaml()` without the section and `_preserveDiskSections` re-attaches the on-disk `links:` block. But that only works when the values originated from the same disk file. Any save path whose in-memory `links` differs from disk (a future settings editor, a fresh file, a programmatic save) silently loses the section — and `_linksYaml()` becomes dead code in the save path.

Fix is one line: add `links: links,` to the `withCustomProviders` field list (the disk-preserved set then only guards future unknown keys, as intended).

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: paid vs beta taps are indistinguishable in the analytics funnel**

Both banner buttons (`_open(_view.appstoreUrl)` and `_open(_view.testflightUrl)`) log the exact same event:

```dart
AppAnalytics.instance.storeReferralTap(
  placement: 'get_banner',
  platform: _platform,
);
```

AC5 requires a *"countable funnel to the paid release"*, and the site side distinguishes `appstore_click` from `testflight_click` — but every in-app tap lands as `store_referral {placement: get_banner, platform}`, with no target dimension. In the shared GA4/Firebase property there is no way to count taps to the paid App Store release separately from free-beta taps, which is precisely the funnel the ticket asks for.

Suggest adding a target dimension, e.g. `storeReferralTap({placement, platform, target})` with `target: 'appstore' | 'testflight'` (or distinct placements `get_banner_appstore` / `get_banner_testflight`), and a widget test pinning the split.

💡 **SUGGESTION: `location` semantics change despite the "continuity" comment; `location`/`placement` now duplicate**

The comment says the existing `location` param is kept for report continuity, but the value changes for referral links: previously `location` was the element's `className` (e.g. `btn btn-primary`), now it becomes the placement (`appstore`/`testflight`). Existing `testflight_click` GA4 reports segmented by `location` will see a new, disjoint value set from this deploy onward — continuity is broken exactly where the comment claims it is kept. Also, when `data-store-referral` is present, `location` and `placement` carry the identical value, which is redundant.

Prefer:

```js
track(named, { location: el.className || 'link', placement: placement || undefined });
```

(only adding `placement` when the attribute exists). Unrelated minor: the homepage block's `data-store-referral="site"` link points at fa1.dev, which `linkEvent()` never maps to a named event, so that attribute is dead — either drop it or handle it.

💡 **SUGGESTION: quote URLs in `toYaml()` (and trim in `_link`) to keep the round-trip safe**

`toYaml()` writes values as bare plain scalars:

```dart
buffer.write('  appstore: $appstore\n');
```

`_link()` validates only `startsWith('http(s)://')`, so a value containing ` #` (e.g. `https://ex.com/app #frag` — a space before the fragment) is accepted by the parser but, once written by `toYaml()`, parses back truncated at the `#` (yaml comment) — the strict round-trip the tests pin breaks for an accepted value. Relatedly, `_link` checks `value.trim().isEmpty` but returns the untrimmed `value`, so leading/trailing whitespace is persisted.

Low-risk fix: emit `appstore: "$appstore"` (double-quoted) in `toYaml()` and `return value.trim()` in `_link`.

💡 **SUGGESTION: `launchUrl` result ignored — a failed open leaves no feedback**

```dart
launchUrl(Uri.parse(url), mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
```

The returned `Future<bool>` is dropped: if no handler can open the URL (rare on web/macOS but possible, e.g. a malformed user override in `links:`), the tap appears to do nothing — and the referral event has already been logged, inflating the funnel with taps that never opened the store. Consider `unawaited(launchUrl(...).then((ok) { if (!ok) ... }))` with at least a log/snackbar, matching the app's existing error-surface patterns. (A config-side mitigation already exists: `LinksConfig._link` validates the URL shape.)

💡 **SUGGESTION: hardcoded English `androidLabel` bypasses l10n**

Every other banner string is localized (en + ru arb), but once `links.play` is set the banner body renders the hardcoded English `'Also on Google Play'` from `StoreBannerView.androidLabel` — the view-model leaks copy into the UI layer and the ru surface gets a mixed-language banner. Not urgent (Play is not live), but the label will be needed the moment `links.play` lands: move the live-Play label into the arb files (e.g. `storeBannerAndroidLive`) now, or leave a TODO at this getter so it is not forgotten.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/unattended), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.

  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through

  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are

## PR Description

Fixes #691

## Delivered

**1. `links:` config section — the foundation (AC1)**
- `lib/src/cli/links_config.dart`: strict-on-shape parse (non-map section, non-URL value, non-boolean banner → `ConfigException`), tolerant notes for unknown keys (AC7), baked-in defaults (appstore / testflight / play: null / site / banner: true), overrides win, `toYaml` round-trip writes only non-default keys.
- Wired into `CliConfig`, `configTopLevelKeys`, `_sectionValidators` (so `fa config get/set/check` treat it as a first-class section — a value the next boot would reject is never persisted) and the disk-preserved save set (a default-valued section never wipes future keys).
- One-change propagation test: flip the link in a `LinksConfig` → site block renderer, in-app banner view, and config get/set all render the new value.

**2. fa1.dev homepage App Store block (AC2, AC6)**
- Generated `#app-store` section (badge + link, paid-release vs free-forever-beta messaging, Android "coming soon" until `links.play` set) between generated markers; `scripts/regen_site_store_block.dart` re-splices it; `test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart` pins byte-equality to the renderer output for the defaults (site can't drift).
- Zero superlative claims — the issue #643 banned-phrase list is asserted on every new surface.

**3. iOS banner page from store goldens (AC3)**
- New `site/app-store/` page shows EXACTLY the five committed en/ios store goldens with the store-story captions.
- `pages.yml` copies `flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png` into the deploy artifact — no hand-copied PNGs exist in the repo, so site assets cannot drift from store assets; the CI test pins page↔golden set equality + the deploy wiring.

**4. Get banners, web + macOS (AC4, AC7)**
- `StoreGetBanner`: dismissible, non-blocking card at the top of Settings (web + macOS only); every URL from the `links:` section via the app loader (web stub = baked-in defaults); dismissal persists (`store_banner.json` in the sandbox root, survives restarts/reloads); `links.banner: false` mounts nothing anywhere.

**5. Store-referral analytics (AC5)**
- In-app: `store_referral {placement, platform}` on banner taps + `store_banner_dismissed` (negative signal) through the AppAnalytics facade.
- Site: `appstore_click {placement}` via `data-store-referral` attrs on every badge (existing `location` param kept for report continuity).
- Counts view: the shared GA4/Firebase property (site gtag + app Firebase already land there) — Events report split by placement/platform/timestamp gives the funnel; no new server (site is static by design).

**Guard rails kept honest**
- `links` documented in the fa-self-config skill (documented-keys sweep + accuracy pins pass); settings-registry classification with a WHY; l10n en+ru for all banner strings; compliance gate extended to the banner + site store copy.
- Analyze: zero errors/warnings, zero issues in touched files (pre-existing infos elsewhere untouched). Dup/crap thresholds NOT touched.

## Remaining
- The GA4 property is the only counts view (no custom dashboard — non-goal-adjacent; a backend would be new surface).
- Android "Get it on Google Play" renders automatically once `links.play` is set (tested with an override; the real link lands when Play ships).
- Store goldens themselves unchanged (post-#643 assets reused as-is).

## Test evidence (local, targeted)
- `dart test`: links_config (21), links_section (12), appstore_assets (6), documented_keys_sweep, settings_completeness, fa_self_config_accuracy, site_llms_guard, cli_config_test, config_service_test — all green.
- `flutter test`: links_loader (6), store_get_banner (7), store_copy_compliance (5), analytics, settings_test — all green. (`settings_golden_test` pixel diffs 1.23% reproduce identically on pristine origin/main in this sandbox — font rasterization, not this change; CI's ubuntu runner renders them clean.)

## Update (rebase + format pass, head 2bc605c0)
- Rebased onto the latest `origin/main` (6cf2c026 — includes the #708 factory repin); content identical to the previous merge head plus the pass below. No conflicts.
- Applied the repo `dart format` to the four touched files the first pass left unformatted (`cli_config.dart`, `flutter_agent_harness.dart` exports, `settings.dart`, `analytics.dart`) — pure reflow, zero semantics, keeps the CI format gate green.
- All targeted gates re-run green on the rebased tree: links_config (21), links_section (12), appstore_assets (6), fa_self_config_accuracy (6), app_bundle_drift (3), store_get_banner (7), links_loader + store_copy_compliance (18 combined).

## CI unblock rider (head 7796555f)
`test/hub/hub_fallback_drill_test.dart` — AC2 UT-fallback — was a deterministic ×2 red on **Core tests (shard 0/4)** (9904abbc / job 105996265643 and 83b09762 / job 105998766365): `SocketException: Address already in use` (errno 98) at `LocalHub.start` on the drill's hub-restart bind, with different ports per run (41663 vs 39459). Cause: the drill picked its port via bind-`:0`→close→rebind, so the restart rebind of the freed port raced the shard's concurrent suites (a neighbor's `:0` bind can be handed the just-freed port and hold it). Fix (test-only, rider commit `7796555f`): every drill hub now binds `:0` and the restart takes a fresh ephemeral port, with the test-owned `GatedTransport` repointing dials at the live hub port — `lib/` untouched.

# gh-691: [GOAL] App Store launch surface: fa1.dev block + iOS banner page from store goldens + Get banners (web/macOS) + store-referral analytics

## Description

## Goal — App Store launch surface: fa1.dev homepage + iOS banner page from store goldens, in-app Get banners (web/macOS), store-referral analytics — and a single config home for product links

### Context (owner)
- PUBLISHED: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163 — the revenue stream. App Store release = paid; public TestFlight beta = free forever; Android mirrors it.
- Visual source = the store golden frames (chat, Weather demo) — site reuses golden-test output; post-#643 assets only.

### NEW: single source of truth for links — `links:` config section (owner requirement)
All product/store links live in ONE place — the `links:` section of `~/.fah/config.yaml` (NOT env vars; this section will grow: play, testflight, site, docs, socials…):
```yaml
links:
  appstore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163
  testflight: <public beta link>
  play: <when live>
  site: https://fa1.dev
```
Strict section parse (ConfigException on bad shape, tolerant notes for unknown keys — repo convention). Every consumer (app banners, CLI, site generator) reads the section — a link changes in ONE place and propagates. Defaults baked in for our own products; user-overridable like any config key.

### Scope
1. **`links:` config section** (above) — the foundation everything else reads.
2. **fa1.dev homepage**: App Store block — badge + link (from `links:`), paid vs free-forever-beta messaging, Android slot (renders "coming soon" until `links.play` set). (Site source location resolved in planning; PR lands where the site lives.)
3. **iOS banner/block page**: built from the golden-test store screenshots; CI-checked regenerate-from-goldens (site assets never drift from store assets).
4. **Get banners**: web + macOS apps' Get surface shows the App Store banner (link from `links:`); dismissible (persisted), non-blocking.
5. **Analytics**: store-referral events — site badge clicks (placement), in-app banner taps, platform split; countable funnel to the paid release.

## Acceptance
- AC1: `links:` section parses strict (bad shape = ConfigException), defaults present, override works; app banner + CLI + site all resolve the SAME value from it (one-change propagation test: flip the link in config → every surface renders the new one).
- AC2: fa1.dev homepage shows the App Store block (badge + link + paid/free-beta messaging); Android "coming soon" until play link set.
- AC3: iOS banner page assets regenerate from the golden suite in CI (no hand-copied PNGs).
- AC4: web + macOS Get banner renders from `links.appstore`; dismissal persists; taps emit analytics events.
- AC5: analytics events countable (placement, platform, timestamp) with a minimal counts view.
- AC6: zero superlative claims on any surface (post-#643 assets; compliance list applies to site/banners too).
- AC7 (REG): site/apps build clean; banner flag off = no surface change; unknown links keys = notes, never crash.

## Non-goals
Pricing/IAP mechanics (App Store Connect); the Play paid release; site i18n beyond existing locales; env-var plumbing (deliberately config-only).

## Links
#643 (compliance fix — asset dependency), store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fa-ai-agent/id6793815163, goldens: flutter_app/test/services/screenshot_golden_test.dart + store-marketing suite.

+/// Resolves the `links:` config section for the app (issue #691): the
+/// SAME section the CLI and the fa1.dev generator read — the app's Get
+/// banner (web/macOS) never hard-codes a store URL, so a link changes
+/// in ONE place (`~/.fah/config.yaml`) and every surface flips. IO
+/// platforms read the real user config; the web stub reports the
+/// baked-in defaults (the browser sandbox has no `~/.fah`).
+///
+/// Unlike the CLI boot (strict — a bad section is a named error), the
+/// app NEVER bricks on config problems: an unreadable or invalid
+/// section falls back to the defaults with a log note, and
+/// `fa config check` remains the loud surface for the error.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+
+export 'links_loader_stub.dart' if (dart.library.io) 'links_loader_io.dart';
+
+/// The effective app links — always a value (defaults when no config
+/// states a choice), plus the load notes for surfaces that want them
+/// (the banner logs them; `banner: false` hides every banner surface).
+final class AppLinksResolution {
+  const AppLinksResolution(this.links, this.notes);
+
+  /// The effective `links:` section.
+  final LinksConfig links;
+
+  /// Load notes: what fell back and why (empty on a clean load).
+  final List<String> notes;
+}

+// Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.

+// in the LICENSE file.
+
+/// IO implementation: reads the user `~/.fah/config.yaml` `links:`
+/// section through the SAME core loader the CLI boot uses
+/// ([loadCliConfig] — its `links:` parse is strict, so a bad shape
+/// surfaces here as a fallback-to-defaults note, never a crash: the app
+/// is not the CLI, `fa config check` is the loud surface).
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+
+import 'app_log.dart';
+import '../sandbox/env_factory_io.dart' show desktopHomeDir;
+import 'links_loader.dart';
+
+/// Resolves the effective links for the app banner surfaces.
+/// [homeDir] overrides the user-home lookup (tests inject a temp dir;
+/// default: [desktopHomeDir]). Absent file/section → the baked-in
+/// defaults; unreadable/invalid → the defaults + a note.
+AppLinksResolution resolveAppLinks({String? homeDir}) {
+  final home = homeDir ?? desktopHomeDir();
+  if (home == null) return const AppLinksResolution(LinksConfig(), []);
+  try {
+    final config = loadCliConfig(home);
+    final notes = [for (final note in config.links.notes) 'links: $note'];
+    return AppLinksResolution(config.links, notes);
+  } on Object catch (error) {
+    final note =
+        'links: config unreadable ($error) — store links fell '
+        'back to the defaults; run `fa config check` for the named error';
+    AppLog.i('links', note);
+    return AppLinksResolution(const LinksConfig(), [note]);
+  }
+}

**Summary**: Solid, well-tested implementation of the #691 store surface — strict/tolerant `links:` parsing, one-source-of-truth propagation with drift-pinning tests, and a sound test-only fix for the hub drill port race. No blocking issues; two important findings: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` drops the new `links` field (violating the in-code "keep in sync" contract — today masked only by the disk-preserved re-attach), and both in-app banner buttons log an identical `store_referral` event, so the paid-vs-beta funnel split required by AC5 cannot be counted.

**Next Steps**:
1. Carry `links: links` in `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (cli_config.dart)
2. Add a `target` (appstore/testflight) param to the banner's `store_referral` event (store_get_banner.dart)

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `withCustomProviders` drops the new `links` field**

The constructor now takes `links` (line 216), but `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (just below, the copy used by `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write union) was not updated — its own doc comment says *"keep this field list in sync with the constructor when a section is added."* The returned copy silently reverts `links` to `const LinksConfig()`.

Today the data loss is masked: `saveCliConfig` emits `toYaml()` without the section and `_preserveDiskSections` re-attaches the on-disk `links:` block. But that only works when the values originated from the same disk file. Any save path whose in-memory `links` differs from disk (a future settings editor, a fresh file, a programmatic save) silently loses the section — and `_linksYaml()` becomes dead code in the save path.

Fix is one line: add `links: links,` to the `withCustomProviders` field list (the disk-preserved set then only guards future unknown keys, as intended).
","path":"outputs/pr_review_comments/comment1.md"}

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: paid vs beta taps are indistinguishable in the analytics funnel**

Both banner buttons (`_open(_view.appstoreUrl)` and `_open(_view.testflightUrl)`) log the exact same event:

```dart
AppAnalytics.instance.storeReferralTap(
  placement: 'get_banner',
  platform: _platform,
);
```

AC5 requires a *"countable funnel to the paid release"*, and the site side distinguishes `appstore_click` from `testflight_click` — but every in-app tap lands as `store_referral {placement: get_banner, platform}`, with no target dimension. In the shared GA4/Firebase property there is no way to count taps to the paid App Store release separately from free-beta taps, which is precisely the funnel the ticket asks for.

Suggest adding a target dimension, e.g. `storeReferralTap({placement, platform, target})` with `target: 'appstore' | 'testflight'` (or distinct placements `get_banner_appstore` / `get_banner_testflight`), and a widget test pinning the split.
","path":"outputs/pr_review_comments/comment2.md"}

{"content":"💡 **SUGGESTION: `location` semantics change despite the "continuity" comment; `location`/`placement` now duplicate**

The comment says the existing `location` param is kept for report continuity, but the value changes for referral links: previously `location` was the element's `className` (e.g. `btn btn-primary`), now it becomes the placement (`appstore`/`testflight`). Existing `testflight_click` GA4 reports segmented by `location` will see a new, disjoint value set from this deploy onward — continuity is broken exactly where the comment claims it is kept. Also, when `data-store-referral` is present, `location` and `placement` carry the identical value, which is redundant.

Prefer:

```js
track(named, { location: el.className || 'link', placement: placement || undefined });
```

(only adding `placement` when the attribute exists). Unrelated minor: the homepage block's `data-store-referral="site"` link points at fa1.dev, which `linkEvent()` never maps to a named event, so that attribute is dead — either drop it or handle it.
","path":"outputs/pr_review_comments/comment3.md"}

{"content":"💡 **SUGGESTION: quote URLs in `toYaml()` (and trim in `_link`) to keep the round-trip safe**

`toYaml()` writes values as bare plain scalars:

```dart
buffer.write('  appstore: $appstore\n');
```

`_link()` validates only `startsWith('http(s)://')`, so a value containing ` #` (e.g. `https://ex.com/app #frag` — a space before the fragment) is accepted by the parser but, once written by `toYaml()`, parses back truncated at the `#` (yaml comment) — the strict round-trip the tests pin breaks for an accepted value. Relatedly, `_link` checks `value.trim().isEmpty` but returns the untrimmed `value`, so leading/trailing whitespace is persisted.

Low-risk fix: emit `appstore: "$appstore"` (double-quoted) in `toYaml()` and `return value.trim()` in `_link`.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/unattended), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — the trajectory ledger core (issue #10): finalized
  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through
  `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder.append`/`applyEvent` — streamed agent events
  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are
  replaced when the real record lands; revision grows per append. Record
  kinds (closed set, `TrajectoryCellKind`): system, user, context,
  compacted, message, tool, subtool — a subtool is a
  `TrajectoryToolRecord.parentCallId != null`, which only hosts build
  directly (the builder never nests). Derived state folds once per
  snapshot: `deriveTrajectoryLayout` (turns of Message/Step groups +
  collapsible turn/assistant-run summaries), `deriveTrajectoryTimeline`
  (four modes — `sequence` equal-width slots, `duration` with idle gaps
  compressed out, `time` zero-width wall-clock markers, `actual` real gaps;
  three fixed lanes: 0 system/user/context, 1 message/compacted, 2 tools),
  `trajectoryTimelineFocusIndexes` (selection → visible ledger indexes),
  and `ThrottledTrajectorySearchIndex` (full-text; matches are stable
  record ids). `formatters.dart` holds the shared duration/token/throughput
  formatting; `trajectory_preview.dart` the bounded single-line previews;
  `trajectory_export.dart` the whole-snapshot JSON/Markdown exporters the
  header's copy menu uses. Tool records carry `startedAt` (real launch
  time, distinct from the projected position) so the Gantt/actual
  projections plot true spans. Outbound model requests persist for the
  ledger as hidden `model_request_summary` `CustomRecord`s — the CLI
  event handler (`agent_event_handler.dart`, emitted through
  `agent_cli.dart`) and the app's `AgentService` both buffer a
  `TrajectoryRequestDetail` per call and flush it onto the session
  record chain right before the assistant message, so replays see it
  ahead of the reply — and `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder` folds them into
  the message record's request detail (the Request tab).
  Consumers render, never re-derive: `packages/fa_ui`'s
  `lib/src/trajectory/` widgets and the CLI `/trajectory` family.
- `lib/src/cli/trajectory_commands.dart` (a `part of` `agent_cli.dart`) +
  `lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.

- `pages.yml` copies `flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png` into the deploy artifact — no hand-copied PNGs exist in the repo, so site assets cannot drift from store assets; the CI test pins page↔golden set equality + the deploy wiring.

**5. Store-referral analytics (AC5)**

- Site: `appstore_click {placement}` via `data-store-referral` attrs on every badge (existing `location` param kept for report continuity).
- Counts view: the shared GA4/Firebase property (site gtag + app Firebase already land there) — Events report split by placement/platform/timestamp gives the funnel; no new server (site is static by design).

**Guard rails kept honest**
- `links` documented in the fa-self-config skill (documented-keys sweep + accuracy pins pass); settings-registry classification with a WHY; l10n en+ru for all banner strings; compliance gate extended to the banner + site store copy.
- Analyze: zero errors/warnings, zero issues in touched files (pre-existing infos elsewhere untouched). Dup/crap thresholds NOT touched.

## Remaining
- The GA4 property is the only counts view (no custom dashboard — non-goal-adjacent; a backend would be new surface).

## Update (rebase + format pass, head 2bc605c0)
- Rebased onto the latest `origin/main` (6cf2c026 — includes the #708 factory repin); content identical to the previous merge head plus the pass below. No conflicts.
- Applied the repo `dart format` to the four touched files the first pass left unformatted (`cli_config.dart`, `flutter_agent_harness.dart` exports, `settings.dart`, `analytics.dart`) — pure reflow, zero semantics, keeps the CI format gate green.

`test/hub/hub_fallback_drill_test.dart` — AC2 UT-fallback — was a deterministic ×2 red on **Core tests (shard 0/4)** (9904abbc / job 105996265643 and 83b09762 / job 105998766365): `SocketException: Address already in use` (errno 98) at `LocalHub.start` on the drill's hub-restart bind, with different ports per run (41663 vs 39459).
